transport.negotiation: call host.info; check features includes tavi.assets/v1; permissions via host session; deny if missing
transport.authentication: host derives caller identity and grants from authenticated extension session; never accept callerId or grants from request
transport.sdk: sdk/client.mjs and sdk/index.d.ts are transport-injected reference clients, not a TaviX runtime implementation

requests.authorization: host-granted customization permission and host-owned user consent policy

requests.format: bounded base64, media type and selected variant; no paths or arbitrary URLs

events.status: not implemented or emitted by Tavi; clients must function without notifications

metadata.rulesRef: opaque identifier for game-owned behavior mapping; never script or executable logic
metadata.rarity: author-declared taxonomy label and tier for display/filtering; no enforced game balance or random probabilities
metadata.ownership: catalog price and pack metadata never provide an entitlement
metadata.modifiers: optional declarative tavi.cards.modifiers.v1 trigger/condition/effects; parsed but never executed by Tavi Assets; game runtime must explicitly opt into and validate profile, op support and balancing

errors: resource too large for inline host transport
security: media capability grants are separate from pack metadata
no purchases or install from extension
all source bytes and references revalidated
